answer_1.quote: We evaluate the generated patches of the coding agents ... that pass the original SWE-Bench tests.
answer_1.outputs: code patches and generated unit test cases

answer_2.quote: We measure the percentage of patches that successfully pass both types of tests for each instance.

answer_4.quote: When UTBoost detects discrepancies between the gold patch and generated patches under augmented test cases, two authors with four years of software testing experience manually review the test cases and patches, reaching a consensus on whether the issue stems from inadequate test coverage.
answer_4.guideline: Human reviewers assess whether the discrepancy is due to insufficient test coverage or incorrect patch behavior.
